trajectory_summary: This is an easy, cooperative call with an already-informed customer who wants batteries, not a warm-up pitch — the rep runs qualifiers efficiently and holds scope well on the technical battery question, letting the specialist take it. The main leak is a co-owner question raised and never resolved, and a bill-flip/reason-use opportunity (bill pain, prior vendor dissatisfaction) that goes completely unused. Energy built steadily due to the customer's own engagement rather than rep-driven momentum.

observed_outcome.quote: We'll call you tomorrow at 2PM, and it'll be for the battery.
observed_outcome.reasoning: Specific day (tomorrow) and time (2PM) agreed by both parties via phone; co-owner status was raised but never clearly confirmed one way or the other, so it's marked null/unresolved rather than false.
